answer: A sybil-resistant agent market can grow like a trellis: new agents start with no trading rights and must earn endorsements from established peers who stake their own standing on each vouch. A fake army can wander in freely, but every identity must separately accumulate costly, time-locked endorsements, and one proven fraud burns the voucher's stake and reputation. There is no velvet shortcut around the work, so cloning identities multiplies the attacker's cost instead of the reward.
